Measured 2026-09-11: the single original caller of this row and of llm_strat_clock_resync_units_and_buildings is llm_strat_sim_clock_advance @0x0044d238, and it is NOT a fixed sequence -- it calls THIS one unconditionally per frame with GAME_CLOCK, and the other one ONLY on the >300 s catch-up branch after advancing the clock by the excess. hosted.why: No MH_EXPORT_REPLACE seam -- order_queue.cpp's nine live seams deliberately exclude stage_scheduled and integrity_check, so the original body serves the hosted call. Its entry libmh_submit_order additionally has NO 1:1 HOSTED COUNTERPART, measured: llm_strat_order_enqueue takes fields plus the scratch args, DISCARDS the whole queue on overflow and returns the new count; llm_strat_order_pending_enqueue masks four ushorts to their low byte and writes PENDING; llm_strat_order_stage_scheduled byte-duplicates into STAGING. The harness replay injector is the closest shape (raw 68-byte records into order_queue) but OVERWRITES from index 0 and SETS the count, while libmh_submit_order APPENDS at the count -- not equivalent when the frame's own enqueues are already in the queue at sim_step entry. So the entry stays never-entered hosted and that measurement is the reason.

api_callers_excused.llm_net_lockstep_dispatch: Both NET callers are bodies libmh ITSELF owns and promotes hosted -- llm_net_lockstep_dispatch is mh::lockstep::dispatch (MH_EXPORT_REPLACE, lockstep/turn_engine.cpp) and llm_net_send_order is mh::lockstep's order emitter (MH_EXPORT_REPLACE, lockstep/tx_emit_order.cpp) -- so at the fork this edge is libmh-INTERNAL, not a crossing. The NET class marks the TRANSPORT DRIVER as host-side; these two are the lockstep/order bodies inside it that libmh already owns, and the host reaches the verified order path through libmh_submit_order rather than calling the verifier itself.

_hosted_classes._what: LIB-SPINE-API: the HOSTED half of a row's disposition -- why this row's promotion seam cannot be routed through its entry in the BROKERED configuration. A row WITHOUT this block must route: gen_libmh_inbound.py's routing census reports it UNROUTED and --check fails, which is the mutation arm that keeps the brokered claim honest.
_hosted_classes.driver-absorbed: the caller is the sim tick DRIVER, which the fork absorbs into the spine
_hosted_classes.boot-blob: served by libmh_import_world / _snapshot, a blob-in entry with no per-body hosted form
_hosted_classes.no-crossing: no MH_EXPORT_REPLACE seam, so hosted the original body runs and nothing crosses
_hosted_classes._api_callers_excused: a row asserting the fork does not export its edge must have NO FE/NET/SESSION caller; each one that exists is excused BY NAME with a measured reason, or the generator fails. This is the entry-side half of the EXCLUSION CONTRADICTED BY A LIVE EDGE check.

_retired_2026_09_12._why: 12 X-TL exclusion rows removed by X-TL-DRAIN step 3. Each body STOPPED BEING AN INBOUND CANDIDATE outright: after the pruned-roots dead-source landed, every remaining caller is an owned body, so there is no original->owned edge left to disposition. This is the X-TL class dissolving by MEASUREMENT rather than by translation -- the callers were dead, not pending. Removing the row is what the generator demands (STALE DISPOSITION); the bodies themselves are untouched and still owned.

_retired_2026_09_12_step4._why: The whole X-TL exclusion class, discharged. These seven rows were excluded because every reaching edge was TRANSLATE-LATER -- an original caller a later batch would absorb. X-TL-DRAIN was that batch, and as of 2026-09-12 each of the seven has NO original caller left: llm_strat_bldg_init_all, llm_strat_bldg_instant_construct_find_slot, llm_unit_order_disembark_soldiers and llm_strat_order_queue_apply_and_dequeue are all `verified` ledger rows now. With no caller they are not inbound CANDIDATES at all, so the generator fails their disposition as STALE by name rather than leaving a dead exclusion behind. THE CLASS ITSELF IS NOW EMPTY (19 -> 0) and `_exclusion_codes` keeps its X-TL definition for the next time a batch needs it.
_retired_2026_09_12_step4._where_the_edges_went: UP one level, not away, and that is why this change also ADDS three covered rows. Translating a caller makes it an owned body, so ITS callers become the inbound edge: llm_strat_input_update (FE) now reaches libmh through llm_strat_bldg_instant_construct_find_slot and llm_unit_order_disembark_soldiers, and llm_boot_stage_tick (SESSION) through llm_strat_bldg_init_all. The commissioning measurement predicted exactly these two callers plus llm_strat_pathfind_dispatch_route_order, which needs no entry because it is itself a provably-dead pruned root. The cascade TERMINATES there: no further original caller is exposed.
